stocks.description: Northeast Bank (NASDAQ: NBN) is headquartered in Portland, Maine and operates a nationwide commercial lending platform alongside a community banking franchise. The Bank's National Lending Division originates and purchases commercial real estate loans, specializing in complex credit structures, secondary-market loan acquisitions, and tailored financing solutions to a diverse national clientele. The Bank's Small Business Division provides government-guaranteed loans as a Small Business Administration Preferred Lender in addition to other small-balance financing solutions. On a regional and national level, Northeast Bank provides a comprehensive suite of depository products and cash management and treasury services through a network of banking centers in Maine and its digital banking division, ableBanking.
